title: Chicagoans arrive in New York; the Pollack band
summary: They note the Chicagoans came 'as a breeze from the far west' around 1927 via the Pollack band.

blocks.x: There were some awful good musicians that came from everywhere in New York at that point. The Chicagoans just came in as a sort of a breeze from the far west.
